DEVICE_CANARY.scope: one exact verified physical worker/enrollment identity

FLEET_CANARY.scope: multiple independently qualified device identities when available

rules: host evidence may not promote DEVICE_CANARY
one device may not promote FLEET_CANARY by duplication or cross-device evidence mixing
a rollback or serious invariant failure demotes to the highest ring whose evidence remains valid
release-ring status is separate from connector availability and scientific/security claim status
